newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon wins Army contract for Patriot.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon wins Army contract for Patriot.

text.p: Raytheon Co said its Raytheon Electronic Systems unit won a $83.4 million contract with the United States Army Missile Command in Huntsville, Alabama to modify and upgrade the Patriot air defense system.

The contract, called the Radar Enhancement Phase 3, has a total value of $201.1 million and makes significant modifications to the Patriot ground equipment radar which will improve its surveillance capabilities, Raytheon said.
Raytheon will work on its portion of the program at its Massachusetts facilities.
